Loot features cover auto drops, chests, pickups, selling to a merchant, fishing, healing items, and retreat/recovery behavior. Visual features include ESP for mobs, bosses, players, NPCs, loot, and chests, plus lighting controls and performance options like low graphics, particle removal, texture hiding, and FPS caps. Travel and movement include tween or instant travel, shrine hops, saved spots, teleports to regions/NPCs/mobs/players, noclip, fly, infinite jump, and speed boost. Safety and management include anti-idle, no-pause, staff detection, auto rejoin/server hop, webhooks, session limits, breaks, theme/config saving, live labels, and a clean unload routine.
